# `•svg` — SVG pictures

`X •svg children` returns an `svg` element with attributes `X`. It adds `xmlns` for the SVG namespace and `viewBox="0 0 100 100"`. Attributes in `X` replace these. With an attributes record as its only argument, `•svg` returns an empty picture: `•svg ["width":200 "height":100]`. An argument that is text or an element tree becomes the children unchanged, as with [`•element`](element.qmd). Notebooks display the `svg` element as a picture. [XML and SVG](../xml.ipynb) covers element trees.
